senses.en: necessary
examples: He could only think of how [[needful]] it was to take the train and get quietly away.

senses.en: limits or borders
examples: We can't really discuss feminism within the [[confines]] of such a short novel.

senses.zh: 限制，束缚（某人或某事物的发展）
senses.en: prevent the development of sb. / sth.
examples: Some people are worried that stricter anti-pollution laws may [[cramp]] economic growth.

senses.en: (fml.) harmful or poisonous
examples: Environmentalists warned that heavy industry pollutes our rivers with [[noxious]] chemicals.

senses.en: used for treating medical problems
examples: Her interest was rekindled when she saw herbs in everyday [[medicinal]] use there.

senses.en: make sth. return to its former state or condition
examples: The government promises to [[restore]] the economy to its full strength by the end of the year.

senses.en: (AmE) a lawyer
examples: He decided to consult with an [[attorney]] about this particular case.

senses.en: a loud unpleasant noise that continues for a long time
examples: They waved their arms and shouted, trying to make themselves heard over the [[din]] of the crowd.

senses.en: ( fml.) skill in making people believe what you want them to believe
examples: He knew how to win by [[craft]] and diplomacy what he could not gain by force.

senses.en: a traditional skill of making things by hand
examples: It's lucky that all kinds of traditional [[craft]] industries are preserved here.

senses.en: (the ~) the line far away where the land or sea seems to meet the sky
examples: He backed away from the edge, looking all around at the flat [[horizon]].

senses.en: (fml.) relating to the body, rather than to the mind, feelings, or spirit
examples: And then there is our own body, our own [[corporeal]] instrument, which we're awfully proud of.

senses.en: an unusual, exciting, or impressive event or sight
examples: Watching a lion chasing its prey is one of nature's most exciting [[spectacles]].

senses.en: move slowly on water or in the air
examples: I looked up at the clouds [[floating]] in the sky.

senses.en: dark purple-red in color
examples: They walked past fields with huge sprays of [[crimson]], yellow and purple flowers.

senses.en: (partook, partaken) (fml.) take part in an activity or event
examples: Retailers who [[partake]] in the campaign should place a sticker on their window.

senses.en: a complete change into sb. / sth. very different, or the process during which this happens
examples: After three weeks, we noticed a total [[transformation]] in his behavior and attitude.

senses.en: the quality of being very pleasant or attractive
examples: As the mountain path spirals up, the beauty of the scene fills each of us with [[enchantment]].

senses.en: become bigger and wider, or make sth. do this
examples: Red wine can help to [[dilate]] blood vessels.

senses.en: secretly plan with sb. to do sth. bad or illegal
examples: The company is accused of [[conspiring]] with three other local stores to fix prices.

senses.zh: 崇拜；把···神化；把···奉若神明
senses.en: treat sb. / sth. with extreme respect and admiration
examples: We are inclined to [[deify]] successful people, and in our time that certainly includes CEOs.

senses.en: formal ceremony, esp. involving expensive clothes, special traditions, etc.
examples: She arrived at the airport without the [[pomp]] that usually accompanies important politicians.

senses.en: (also faery) a fairy
(also mystical) involving religious, spiritual, or magical powers that people cannot understand
examples: He has undergone a profound [[mystic]] experience over the past two months.

senses.zh: 易受影响（或感染）的倾向；敏感性
senses.en: the tendency to be easily affected or influenced by sth.
examples: One of the side effects of the drug is an increased [[susceptibility]] to infection.

senses.en: a small thin piece that breaks away easily from sth. else
examples: Toward the middle of the night, large [[flakes]] of snow began to fall swiftly.

senses.en: (fml.) change sth., esp. in order to achieve a particular effect
examples: Teachers [[modulate]] the way they work in response to their students' needs.

senses.en: a small amount of a particular color
examples: Green has many different shades and [[tints]].

senses.en: a calm or relaxed state
examples: The atmosphere in the hall is one of [[repose]] rather than excitement.

senses.en: (also calyx) (pl. calices)
cover sth. with frost
examples: He does not brush away the frost that [[rimes]] his beard.

senses.en: not speaking, or not willing to speak
examples: Marianna, the king's daughter, became [[mute]] after a shock.

senses.en: friendly and kind
examples: He was a warm-hearted friend and [[genial]] host, liked by everyone he met.

senses.en: (beheld, beheld) see sth.
examples: He looked up and [[beheld]] a stranger sitting across the table, smiling a secret smile.

senses.en: great beauty
examples: It will cost millions of pounds to [[restore]] the castle into its former [[glory]].

senses.en: admiration and praise that you get because you have done sth. impressive
examples: Walsham had his moment of [[glory]] when he won a 20 km race last week in London.

senses.en: darkness in which it is difficult to see clearly
examples: She peered into the [[gloom]], but she couldn't see where the noise was coming from.

senses.en: make sb. / sth. different
examples: This doesn't [[alter]] the fact that what you did was wrong. You'd better call him and apologize.

senses.zh: 一连串，一系列（同类型的人或物）
senses.en: a series of people or things of the same type
examples: I can't understand why after graduation he took a [[succession]] of low-paid jobs.

senses.en: a group of related animals or plants
examples: They didn't quite expect that this [[tribe]] of cats could give them so much trouble.

senses.en: a social group consisting of people of the same race who have the same beliefs, language, etc. and usually live in one particular area ruled by their leader
examples: The elders in the [[tribe]] want to protect their traditional way of life.

senses.en: arriving or happening at the time agreed on
examples: She's always very [[punctual]] for appointments and because of this she is highly respected.

senses.en: (of trees or plants) produce flower
examples: Most roses will begin to [[bloom]] from late May and the garden will be at its best.

senses.en: (of people, animals, etc.) move around in a large group
examples: Every day tourists [[swarm]] through the narrow streets of the old city.

senses.en: continuing all the time
examples: I thought her [[perpetual]] complaints were going to prove too much for me.

senses.zh: 特别演出；欢庆活动；庆典
senses.en: a special performance or event to celebrate sth.
examples: We ate dinner and watched the Spring Festival [[Gala]] together on New Year's Eve.

senses.en: a small attractive object used for decoration or for making sb. / sth. more beautiful
examples: I guessed he was the chief because he wore more gold [[ornaments]] than the others.

senses.en: wet with drops of dew
examples: The grass was [[dewy]], the apples green, but already fragrant.

senses.en: a flower on a tree, or all the flowers on a tree
examples: Rain begins to fall and peach trees are in [[blossom]].

senses.en: (fml.) laugh at sb. / sth. in an unkind way, esp. by copying what they say or do
examples: The other children [[mocked]] the girl's French accent, laughing behind their hands.

senses.zh: 仅仅的，只不过（用于强调小或微不足道）
senses.en: used to emphasize how small or unimportant sb. / sth. is
examples: We don't consider our customers to be [[mere]] consumers; we consider them to be our friends.

senses.en: shine with a soft light that looks as if it shakes slightly
examples: My thoughts [[shimmer]] with the shimmering leaves and my heart sings with the touch of this sunlight.

senses.en: hold sth. tightly because one does not want to lose it
examples: The young man stood in the doorway, his invitation [[clutched]] tightly in his hand.

senses.en: an effect caused by hot air in deserts, at sea, or on roads, which makes you think that you can see objects when they are not actually there
examples: She thought at first it must be the edge of an oasis, then realized it was a [[mirage]].

senses.en: (fml.) the attitude or behavior of sb. who works very hard and very carefully
examples: We should cultivate the good habits of [[diligence]] and frugality (节俭).

senses.en: a sign that sth. is soon going to happen
examples: If this first opera of the season is a [[herald]] of what is to come, we can expect great things.

senses.en: felt or experienced in your own mind but not expressed to other people
examples: She watched his expression, saw the relaxation of his features, and breathed an [[inward]] sigh of relief.

senses.en: toward the inside or center of sth.
examples: The car was not severely damaged — only the middle of the car door was bent [[inward]].

senses.en: (also as long as) used before saying the conditions that will make sth. else happen or be true
examples: So long as you try your best, it doesn't matter whether you win or not.

senses.en: used for including other similar people or things in what you are saying
examples: Many words are compounds, such as blackboard, inkpot, bookstore, and the like.

senses.zh: 亚述（古代东方奴隶制国家）
帕福斯（塞浦路斯西南部古城）
